script.text:
set -e
apt-get update && apt-get install -y osmium-tool gdal-bin curl git
curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
mkdir -p /mnt/disks/batch-disk/geodashing-work
cd /mnt/disks/batch-disk/geodashing-work
curl -L https://planet.openstreetmap.org/pbf/planet-latest.osm.pbf -o planet-latest.osm.pbf
git clone https://github.com/lucienve/geodashing-v2.git repo
cd repo
uv sync
uv run python -m backend.scripts.prepare_roads --input /mnt/disks/batch-disk/geodashing-work/planet-latest.osm.pbf --output /mnt/disks/batch-disk/geodashing-work/world_drivable_roads.gpkg --upload-gcs
